storeDetails.title: Store details
storeDetails.description: Shown on receipts, invoices and exported reports.
storeDetails.timezoneHint: Used for date-based rules like batch expiry.
storeDetails.allowSellerViewCostHint: When on, sellers see the cost price alongside selling price in Products.
storeDetails.advancedFeaturesHint: Off by default. Turn on only what your store needs — simple stores can ignore these.

units.label: Units of measure
units.description: Sell by piece, kg, g, L or pack. Adds a unit field on products.

categoryAttributes.label: Category attributes
categoryAttributes.description: Add structured specs per category (brand, warranty, weight…). Coming in a later update.

customVariantAxes.label: Custom variant axes
customVariantAxes.description: Define your own variant axes beyond Size/Color (Storage, Voltage…). Coming in a later update.

expiryBatch.label: Expiry & batch tracking
expiryBatch.description: Track expiry dates and batches for perishable goods. Coming in a later update.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how the dashboard looks on this device.

starterCatalog.title: Starter catalog
starterCatalog.description: Optional. Set up categories, attributes and variant options for a common store type in one click. It never creates products or stock, and never overwrites existing data.
starterCatalog.alreadySetUp: Your catalog is already set up — open to apply another starter template
starterCatalog.appliedDescription: Here is what changed for your store.
starterCatalog.nothingChanged: Everything was already set up — nothing was changed.
starterCatalog.previewFooter: This only sets up catalog structure. It does not create any products, stock, or sales, and it never overwrites what you already have.
